headlines.description: — Fabian Zetterlund scored with less that two-and-a-half minutes remaining to give the Ottawa Senators a 4-3 win over the Washington Capitals on Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Zetterlund's 10th goal of the season late in the 3rd period gives Senators a 4-3 win over Capitals

events.name: Utah Mammoth at New York Islanders

headlines.description: — Dylan Guenther had his first career hat trick and added an assist and the Utah Mammoth topped the New York Islanders 7-2 on Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dylan Guenther has 1st career hat trick to send Mammoth to 7-2 victory over Isles

events.name: Winnipeg Jets at Toronto Maple Leafs

headlines.description: — Auston Matthews scored his 14th career hat trick and added an assist to lead the Toronto Maple Leafs to a 6-5 comeback win against the struggling Winnipeg Jets on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Matthews scores a hat trick to lead Maple Leafs to 6-5 comeback win over Jets

events.name: Detroit Red Wings at Pittsburgh Penguins

headlines.description: — Kris Letang scored 58 seconds into overtime in his 1,200th NHL game and the Pittsburgh Penguins beat the Detroit Red Wings 4-3 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Letang scores in OT in his 1,200th game to give Penguins 4-3 win against Red Wings

headlines.description: — Cole Caufield and Josh Anderson scored 23 seconds apart in the second period, and the Montreal Canadiens erased a two-goal deficit in beating the Carolina Hurricanes 7-5 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Quick strikes from Caufield and Anderson help Canadiens rally for 7-5 win over Hurricanes

events.name: Tampa Bay Lightning at Los Angeles Kings

headlines.description: — Gage Goncalves scored the tiebreaking goal with 1:41 to play, and the Tampa Bay Lightning rallied from a late deficit to beat the Los Angeles Kings 5-3 on Thursday night for their sixth consecutive victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cirelli, Goncalves key Lightning's 3rd-period comeback for their 6th straight win, 5-3 over LA Kings

headlines.description: — Ilya Mikheyev had two goals and the Chicago Blackhawks handed the Dallas Stars their fourth consecutive loss with a 4-3 victory Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mikheyev scores twice as the Blackhawks beat the slumping Stars 4-3

headlines.description: — Matty Beniers scored twice during the Seattle Kraken's three-goal first period and Philipp Grubauer stopped 24 shots in a 4-1 win over the Nashville Predators on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Beniers scores twice in Kraken's 4-1 win over Predators
